title: Message times — real day and time, kept after reopening

steps.path: Any conversation, the small time under each message
steps.headline: Older messages now show their date instead of a time that looks like today.
steps.changed: The time under a message reads "2:34 PM" for today, "Yesterday at 2:34 PM" for yesterday, and just the date ("Jul 29, 2025") before that. This test chat is from July 2025, so it shows dates.
steps.notice: A reply's time is when it last changed, so a reply that worked for 40 minutes shows when it finished, not when it started. Reopened chats keep their real times instead of all showing the moment you reopened them.
steps.risk: A chat left open past midnight keeps showing only the time on yesterday's messages until they redraw.

steps.path: The same chat at phone width
steps.headline: The longer date label still fits inside the bubble on a phone.
steps.notice: Nothing wraps or overlaps; the label stays on one line in the bubble's corner.
steps.risk: "Yesterday at 12:45 PM" is the longest label, so a one-word message's bubble can grow slightly wider to hold it.
